claim: Before publishing, walk every leak channel, not only source files: placeholders and defaults, literal counts and constants, fixtures, archives and spreadsheets, images, commit messages, branch names, full history, forks and cached views, setup helpers pasted into live scripts, browser storage, handoff notes, chat exports and agent memory itself.
conditions: writing agent memory about a leak
